text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: URGENT - spike in tail latency and elevated 5xx for tenant=CobaltTrust (dedicated-vpc-eu-west-2). p99 1.1s -> 4.8s; 5xx 0.3% -> 6.4%. Autoscaler queued requests rising on pool `dedicated-eu-7`. Paging oncall.

leo_sre: ack. I'm looking. pulling trace spans and CPU/GPU utilisation.

mira_ml: pinged. early signs show repeated KV eviction logs on model `cobalt-keeper-v2` for tenant CobaltTrust. Many queries include user_summaries with >120k tokens (their audit export flows). That could be thrashing KV and causing extra memory pressure.

tara_support: CobaltTrust reports timeouts across enrichment pipeline; they've opened a severity-2 ticket CT-2248. They're asking if this is related to their recently increased batch size.

leo_sre: quick health check output:
```
# redwoodctl status --tenant cobalttrust --pool dedicated-eu-7 --replicas
replica-7: restarted (oom_count=2)
replica-8: slow_resp
replica-9: healthy
```

mira_ml: recommend emergency mitigation: override tenant routing to `cobalt-keeper-lite-1` (quantized, narrower context support) and apply request-level max_context_tokens=8192 to avoid huge KV growth. This should preserve semantics for transaction-level prompts.

leo_sre: mitigation options considered:
- A: pin to lite variant now (fast)
- B: scale pool by +3 replicas and warm (slower, may prolong OOM churn)
- C: route to hosted fallback (requires tenancy review)

sam_oncall: I'm oncall takeover. I'll coordinate execution and pager duty handoff.

tara_support: customer impact summary: critical enrichment and compliance checks failing intermittently (affects ~18% of their api calls). They're throttling client retries to reduce load. Need clear ETA and rollback plan.

devin_account: looping in CobaltTrust CSM. Please keep update minimal and state we're "applying an emergency routing override; investigating root cause."

leo_sre: executing A now. Applying route override and context cap.
```
redwoodctl route override --tenant cobalttrust --model cobalt-keeper-lite-1 --strategy pin --duration 45m --reason "emergency latency/5xx mitigation"
redwoodctl tenant update-config --tenant cobalttrust --max_context_tokens 8192
```

incident-bot: change submitted. change_id=chg-90001. Applying to dedicated-eu-7.

mira_ml: also recommend toggling kv_cache.eviction_policy to LRU-shrink for this tenant to reduce thrash while we diagnose.

leo_sre: applied pin and context cap. Immediate telemetry: p99 -> 940ms, 5xx -> 1.1%. Queue depth stabilizing. Linking dashboard: https://dashboard.redwood.ai/cobalttrust/throughput?range=15m

tara_support: update sent to customer at 11:06 UTC: "We've applied a temporary model variant to reduce latency and errors. We'll run regression checks and follow up with RCA." They replied: "Thanks, keep us posted."

sam_oncall: setting 45m timer and will run manual check at expiry. Also created a temporary incident board: https://kanban.redwood.ai/incidents/CT-2248

mira_ml: running quick evals against `cobalt-keeper-lite-1` using CobaltTrust's golden set `cobalt-gold-v2`. Preliminary: intent match 98.9% (no major semantic regressions), tokenization diffs on long documents expected. If any customer-critical prompt fails >1.5% we'll escalate to staged canary.

leo_sre: scaled pool by +1 as a safety buffer (avoid over-scaling which can cause pre-warm churn).
```
redwoodctl pool scale --name dedicated-eu-7 --delta 1
```

incident-bot: pool scale completed.

devin_account: scheduling 13:30 UTC customer sync. Also requesting post-incident write-up and any recommended configuration changes for their production workload.

mira_ml: opened model investigation ticket ML-4122 to analyze KV shard sizing and memory footprint differences between `cobalt-keeper-v2` and `cobalt-keeper-lite-1`. Possible long-term fixes: reduce KV shard size for enterprise tenants with bursty long-context usage, or provide client-side SDK helpers to chunk large audit exports.

leo_sre: action items created:
- SRE: implement autoscaler alert for rapid context-length surge (leo_sre)
- ML: KV eviction tuning and regression tests (mira_ml)
- Support/Account: customer communication and RCA scheduling (tara_support/devin_account)

sam_oncall: I'll own the 45m check and confirm rollback. If metrics remain stable we'll revert pin and reintroduce original model with a staged 10%->50%->100% rollout.

tara_support: customer message update posted at 11:20 UTC. They appreciate the quick action.

leo_sre: timeline:
- 11:05 alert -> 11:07 triage
- 11:12 routing pin + config cap applied
- 11:18 p99 improved, 5xx reduced to ~1%
- 11:22 scaling +1 replica

mira_ml: note: we should also audit recent model pushes; check if `cobalt-keeper-v2` had a parameter change to KV shard allocation in last deploy. Opening ML-deploy audit.

devin_account: will collect customer logs to correlate with request patterns and include in the RCA.

sam_oncall: 45m timer set; I'll post final status here at 11:57 UTC or earlier if we roll back. Leaving thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
